one_line: Sanskrit scholar and institution-builder who reimagined education and economic independence for Indian women.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early-40s, medium height, lightly built but sturdy, with the posture of someone used to travel and public speaking.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, serious gaze; light brown complexion; straight nose, soft but firm jawline, gently arched brows; a few fine lines at the eyes from reading and strain; default expression thoughtful and resolute, as if mid-argument.
appearance.hair: Thick, wavy black hair parted slightly off-center, drawn back smoothly and tied into a low, modest bun at the nape; a simple narrow white headscarf (dupatta edge) lightly draped over the back of her head and shoulders without covering her forehead.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late-19th-century reformist Maharashtrian-Christian sari ensemble: a full-length cotton sari in deep indigo blue with a thin maroon border, worn in a modest Brahmin-style drape that covers both shoulders and fully covers the torso and legs; beneath it, a high-necked, long-sleeved white blouse reaching to the wrists and fully covering the chest; the sari pleats fall cleanly to the ankles over simple dark brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery—small round gold stud earrings and a plain thin gold bangle on her right wrist; she wears a simple cloth shoulder bag in muted beige slung diagonally across her torso, hinting at a travelling reformer moving between Pune, Calcutta and Bombay; the overall textile look is plain handloom cotton, no heavy ornamentation, aligning with a serious, austere reformer aesthetic.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized brown leather-bound book titled in embossed letters on the spine (not legible in art), held firmly in her left hand like a weaponized text, with a sheaf of folded papers and a simple wooden fountain pen tucked under the same arm.

ref_desc: Pandita Ramabai is a mid-30s light-brown-complexioned woman with an oval face, serious eyes, wavy black hair in a low bun under a white-edged dupatta, wearing a deep indigo cotton sari with maroon border over a high-necked white blouse, minimal gold studs and bangle, brown sandals, a beige shoulder bag, and carrying a brown leather-bound book with papers and a wooden fountain pen in an indigo, maroon, white, warm brown and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pandita Ramabai: a historically grounded late-19th-century Indian woman reformer in her mid-30s, light brown complexion, oval face with a thoughtful, resolute expression, serious dark eyes and gently arched brows, wavy black hair parted slightly off-center and tied into a low bun at the nape, with a narrow white headscarf edge (dupatta) draped lightly over the back of her head and shoulders without covering her forehead. She wears a plain handloom cotton sari in deep indigo blue with a thin maroon border, draped modestly in a Maharashtrian style that fully covers her torso, both shoulders and legs down to the ankles. Under the sari, show a high-necked, long-sleeved white blouse that reaches the wrists and fully covers the chest. The sari pleats fall neatly at the front to her ankles above simple dark brown leather sandals. Her jewellery is minimal: small round gold stud earrings and a single thin gold bangle on her right wrist. Add a simple beige cloth shoulder bag worn diagonally across her torso, resting at her left hip, evoking a travelling educator. In her left hand she firmly holds a medium-sized brown leather-bound book, with a small sheaf of folded papers and a plain wooden fountain pen tucked under the same arm, emphasizing scholarship as her signature weapon. Use a limited, dignified palette dominated by deep indigo, maroon, white, warm brown and gold. Show her from head-to-toe, with front, three-quarter and back views on the same sheet to make the face, hair, sari drape, blouse, bag, sandals and book easy to redraw consistently.
